channel.description: Surprising facts about UAE, Saudi Arabia, and the world.

item.title: Opening a Bank Account in Egypt: Guide
item.description: How foreign residents can open a bank account in Egypt: required documents, choosing a bank, account types, and practical tips for expats and long-term visitors.

item.title: Egypt Driving Guide: Rentals & Road Rules
item.description: Should you rent a car in Egypt? Car rental requirements, an International Driving Permit, road conditions, and why most visitors use drivers instead in 2026.

item.title: Nile Cruise Guide: Luxor to Aswan Trip Planning
item.description: How to plan a Nile cruise between Luxor and Aswan: cruise length options, what's included, choosing a ship, temple stops, and practical booking tips for 2026.

item.title: Cairo International Airport Guide
item.description: Navigating Cairo International Airport (CAI): terminals, visa on arrival, getting into the city, SIM cards, and practical tips for a smooth arrival in 2026.

item.title: Egypt Safety Guide for Travelers
item.description: Practical safety information for visiting Egypt in 2026: general crime, road safety, common tourist scams, health precautions, and staying informed while traveling.

item.title: Egypt Tipping & Baksheesh Guide
item.description: Understanding tipping in Egypt: what baksheesh means, typical amounts for restaurants, hotels, guides, and drivers, and practical tips for 2026.

item.title: The History of Fresco Painting
item.description: Michelangelo had roughly eight hours before each patch of plaster dried, mistakes and all. Here is how fresco painting works and why it forces total commitment.

item.title: The History of Pinball Machines
item.description: Pinball survived a decades-long ban in several major cities before becoming a bar-and-arcade fixture. Here's how a coin-operated novelty turned into a game of skill.

item.title: The History of Stained Glass Art
item.description: Stained glass windows turned church walls into glowing storytelling devices for a population who mostly couldn't read. Here's how the technique developed over a thousand years.

item.title: The History of Tabletop Role-Playing Games
item.description: Dungeons & Dragons grew out of a hobby for refighting Napoleonic battles with miniature figures. Here's how tabletop RPGs became their own category of game.

item.title: The History of the Abacus
item.description: Long before calculators, merchants used a simple frame of beads to add, subtract, and multiply at remarkable speed. Here's how it evolved across civilizations.

item.title: The History of the Jigsaw Puzzle
item.description: The jigsaw puzzle started as a geography teaching tool cut apart with a hand saw, not as a toy for children to play with. Here's how it became a global pastime.

item.title: The History of the Kaaba's Kiswah
item.description: The Kiswah, the Kaaba's black silk covering, is remade every year using 670kg of silk and gold thread. Here's the history behind this tradition.

item.title: The History of the Rubik's Cube
item.description: The Rubik's Cube was invented as a teaching tool in 1974 and has 43 quintillion possible combinations. Here's the story behind the iconic puzzle.

item.title: How Trivia Games Became So Popular
item.description: From radio quiz shows to Trivial Pursuit to pub trivia nights, here's how the simple pleasure of testing knowledge became a global pastime.

item.title: How Ancient Egyptians Told Time
item.description: Ancient Egyptians divided the day into 24 hours using sundials and water clocks thousands of years before mechanical clocks existed.

item.title: How Blood Types Work
item.description: Blood types are defined by antigens Karl Landsteiner discovered in 1901. Here's how the ABO and Rh systems work and why matching matters.

item.title: How Coral Reefs Form
item.description: Coral reefs are built by tiny polyps over thousands of years, powered by a hidden partnership with algae. Here's how these structures form.

item.title: How Do Credit Scores Actually Work?
item.description: A credit score compresses years of borrowing behavior into a single number lenders use to judge risk. Here's what actually goes into the calculation, and why it can vary.

item.title: How Currency Pegs Work
item.description: The UAE dirham and Saudi riyal have stayed locked to the US dollar for decades. Here is what a currency peg actually does and what it costs a central bank to defend one.
